@graph.name: Medical Bundle
@graph.description: Get additional enhancements to Travel Medical Expense coverage and evacuation-related coverages when you pack a Travel Guard® travel insurance plan with our Medical Bundle.

acceptedAnswer.text: The Medical Bundle is a great option for travelers looking for higher benefit limits for medical expenses than what is offered in their base Travel Guard travel insurance plan, as well as coverage not otherwise included like hospital of choice for emergency evacuation and a variety of ancillary evacuation coverages. Whether you’re nervous to travel or just want the extra coverage, Travel Guard’s Medical Bundle is a great addition to pack on your trip.

mainEntity.name: Can I add the Medical Bundle to my existing travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! On applicable plans, you can add it to your travel insurance plan to ensure you have the coverage you may need. However, if you already have a Deluxe Plan, there is no need to get additional coverage since the enhancements of the Medical Bundle are already included in your plan.

mainEntity.name: Does Travel Guard’s Medical Bundle meet the Schengen Visa requirements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Preferred and Deluxe base plans meet the Schengen Visa requirements.

mainEntity.name: What does the Medical Bundle cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Medical Bundle provides higher benefit limits to Travel Medical Expense coverage in your travel insurance plan and also adds additional benefits such as hospital of choice for emergency evacuation and more ancillary evacuation coverages; these are available to view in your travel insurance plan.

mainEntity.name: How can I learn more about the Medical Bundle?

acceptedAnswer.text:
For additional information on the Medical Bundle, review your policy of insurance or call our specially trained representatives at 800.826.5248. Remember, it’s always a good idea to read over your policy of insurance when purchasing a travel insurance plan!
